self.description: Series of string values without missing values
Series of numeric (float) values without NaN
self.constraints: st.lists(st.floats(allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False, min_value=-100.0, max_value=100.0), min_size=1, max_size=20).map(pd.Series)

self.description: Series containing at least one NaN/None value; 'the sentinel -1 will be used for NaN values'
self.constraints: st.lists(st.one_of(st.text(alphabet='abcde', min_size=1, max_size=3), st.none()), min_size=2, max_size=20).filter(lambda x: any(v is None for v in x)).map(pd.Series)

self.description: Categorical-backed Series; 'When values is Categorical, uniques is a Categorical'
Series where all elements are identical — uniques should have exactly 1 entry
self.constraints: st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=5).flatmap(lambda n: st.integers(min_value=-100, max_value=100).map(lambda v: pd.Series([v] * n)))

self.description: Empty Series — zero-length input edge case

sort.description: sort=False (default): uniques appear in order of first occurrence, codes not shuffled
sort=True: 'Sort uniques and shuffle codes to maintain the relationship'

use_na_sentinel=False: 'NaN values will be encoded as non-negative integers and will not drop the NaN from the uniques'
